attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Elias knelt in the snow, his fingers trembling as he brushed the frost from his mother’s stiffened hand.","reason":"The briefing never places Elias in the caravan or at the site of her death."},{"span":"gripped the reins of the remaining pack mule","reason":"The caravan was lost; no surviving mule or animal is mentioned."}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The scene is clear and ends on a fitting resolve, but it invents Elias's presence at the death site and a surviving pack mule. Lines like 'the wind howled... mocking the silence' tip into melodrama."}
